job.title: Software Engineer II - CIAM
job.pay_full: $165,000 – $225,000 a year base in CA, WA, NY, NJ and CT; $146,000 – $206,000 a year in all other US states

details.about: Affirm gives people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees. It is building its next generation of customer identity and authentication, and this hands-on, mid-level role in Information Security works on core customer identity and access management (CIAM): the backend services behind registration, login, authorization and account lifecycle across consumer and business experiences.
duties: Build and ship customer-facing authentication features, from smoother login to MFA, step-up authentication and device binding, with mentorship from experienced engineers
Develop backend services and APIs in Python or Kotlin
Work with identity technologies such as Okta, Auth0 and ForgeRock, writing custom code and integrations for web, mobile and partner apps
Take scoped features through design, code, automated tests, code review and production deployment
Debug services, improve reliability and use logs and metrics to understand code in production
Collaborate with engineering and product partners and learn secure development practices
needs: Demonstrated ability to write, test and debug software in Python, Kotlin or a similar language (coursework, internships, personal projects, open source or professional work); no fixed minimum years of experience
Foundational understanding of backend development: APIs, data structures, databases and version control
Curiosity about how authentication works; prior identity protocol or CIAM experience is a plus, not a requirement
A practical problem-solving approach and openness to learning through mentorship and code review
Clear communication and collaboration with engineering, product and security teammates
Equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field
details.benefits: USA base pay per year: $165,000 – $225,000 in CA, WA, NY, NJ and CT; $146,000 – $206,000 in all other US states. New hires typically start at the start of the range. Total compensation may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage plus dental and vision for you and your dependents, flexible time off and an employee stock purchase plan.
notes: Affirm is remote-first; new hires are invited to an in-person onboarding
Base Pay Grade L, Equity Grade 6
